title: A necessary condition for cylindrical curves in terms of curvature and torsion
summary: We establish necessary conditions for a regular curve to lie on a circular cylinder in terms of its curvature $κ$ and torsion $τ$. By identifying a fundamental function $ψ= \sin^2 α$, representing the squared sine of the angle between the tangent vector and the axis of the cylinder, we reduce the geometric inclusion problem to a compatibility condition between an explicit eighth-degree polynomial equation and a differential equation for $ψ$. This approach yields a single ODE involving only $κ$ and $τ$ that governs the inclusion of the curve in the cylinder. The robustness of this framework…
